senses.gloss: pole, scaffolding, gallows. Targ. II Esth. II, 7; a. e.—
units: <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 10:10">Targ. I Chr. X, 10</cite> <cite ref="G00657"><he>זיק׳</he></cite>.—

Meg. 16ᵇ וי״ו … למימתחה כז׳ (Asheri כי ז׳; ed. בז׳ incorr.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6) you must extend the Vav of ויזתא (Esth. IX, 9) as long as a pole; כולהו בחד ז׳ וכ׳ (ed. זקיפה, Ms. H. 2 בז׳ חדא; Asheri בחדא ז׳) they were all hanged on one pole (at the same execution, v. infra).—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 83b:10">B. Mets. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>תותי ז׳</he> under the gallows.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18b:2">Ab. Zar. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>אסקוה לז׳</he> they took him out for execution.
